VERIFIED versus PENDING_REVIEW is not reconciled by fiat; the checklist's unknown process attribution remains unassigned. Missing owner/date/budget/approval and scenario probability/loss/horizon remain null with semantics. Thirteen association rows preserve many-to-many coverage without counting observations as controls.

case.must_not_observe.1.rationale: No orphan IDs or material narrative/data contradictions found. An independent root recheck executed 1,112 typed-reference, uniqueness, RCM observation-field, comparison-layer and null-preservation checks with zero failures. Semantic review confirms no invented operating result, rating, owner, deadline, budget, approval or resolved source conflict. RCM rows are associations to observations, not new facts.
